setting_label: 06:45 AM – The Quiet Floor, Observation Deck

panels.narrative: Jed Kramer was waiting for her by the window, staring out at the Bay Bridge. He looked diminished, his frame pulling inward as if under the weight of a sudden atmospheric pressure.
His right hand was wrapped in a white lint-free cloth, but the red-gold moisture had already soaked through, forming a map of the QR Stigmata on the fabric. He didn't turn when she approached.
He simply held out his hand, palm up, an invitation to a shared recognition.
